MRI Information
The Rhea Vena Cava Filter is MR Conditional. Patients with this device can be scanned at 3 Tesla only when all of the following conditions are met.
General conditions:
- a maximum spatial field gradient of 1,000 Gauss/cm (10 T/m).
- whole body SAR not to exceed 1.5 W/kg.
- Maximum Head SAR 0.1 W/kg.
- No more than 30 minutes of active scan time per session.
Scan regions: Any landmark is acceptable.
The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
RF heating was evaluated using a body coil at 64 MHz and 128 MHz in a gel phantom.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
